letter.subject: Update on your loan application
letter.body:
Thank you for applying with us. We are writing to let you know that your application is under review. This means it is close to the approval threshold, so a loan officer will look at it personally before a final decision is made.

We reviewed several parts of your application. The main factors that lowered our confidence were external credit scores that are on the low side, a requested loan amount that is somewhat higher than the price of the goods it would cover, and a repayment period of about 18 payments. Lenders look at these factors because they help show how well a loan can be repaid.

Your application also has real strengths. Your car is about 4 years old, and none of your payments were late in the last year. On-time payments show a reliable repayment record, which we value.

A loan officer may be able to offer a loan of 508,842 with regular payments of about 27,718 over about 18 payments. We may contact you to talk through adjusting the loan terms. This would be a possibility for the loan officer to confirm, not a guarantee.

If you have questions in the meantime, please reply to this letter.

The Lending Team
